description: Find and compare recorded accessibility facts with gaps and conflicting reports visible.

tools.name: spots_inspect
tools.description: Inspect allowlisted public accessibility question reports for a source spot ID. Required: id. Returns the new SpotRecord.

tools.name: spots_search
tools.description: Search public spot records by source keyword, category, and evidence record dates. Optional: query, category, from (plus 4 more). Returns array of TimelineRecord.

params.name: query
params.description: Source keyword; original language often matches best.

params.name: category
params.description: Source category; public CLI accepts comma-separated categories.

params.name: from
params.description: Inclusive evidence record date; public CLI converts its explicit timezone to UTC.

params.name: to
params.description: Inclusive evidence record date; public CLI converts its explicit timezone to UTC.

params.name: type
params.description: Only public spot records are in scope.

novel_features.name: Requested-question comparison
novel_features.description: Align requested source question IDs and report supporting, opposing, mixed, unknown and inapplicable evidence.

novel_features.name: Detail-checked discovery
novel_features.description: Expand a bounded keyword shortlist into actual detail evidence for requested questions.

novel_features.name: Saved-observation changes
novel_features.description: Show exact changes between two allowlisted source observations for selected public places.

novel_features.name: Recheck queue
novel_features.description: Prioritize old, unknown or conflicting evidence in a saved shortlist with explicit reasons.

novel_features.name: Nearest saved facilities
novel_features.description: Rank saved public facilities by straight-line distance from an explicit origin.
